verse.verse_1: I CALL TO witness those who scatter (dust) by dispersing,
verse.verse_2: And those who bear the load (of rain),
verse.verse_3: And those who move (on the water) gently,
verse.verse_4: And those who distribute (it) by command,
verse.verse_5: Verily the promise made to you is true:
verse.verse_6: The Judgement will indeed take place.
verse.verse_8: You are surely caught in contradictions.,
verse.verse_9: From which only he turns who is turned away.
verse.verse_10: Perish will those who just guess and speculate,
verse.verse_12: They ask: "When is the Day of Judgement?" --
verse.verse_13: The day they will be burnt in the Fire,
verse.verse_14: (And told:) "Taste your punishment. This is what you were trying to hasten."
verse.verse_15: Surely those who fear God and follow the straight path will be amidst gardens and fresh springs of water,
verse.verse_16: Receiving what is given them by their Lord. They were surely the virtuous before this.
verse.verse_17: They slept little in the night,
verse.verse_19: In whose wealth the suppliant and the deprived had a share.
verse.verse_20: There are signs in the earth for those who are firm in their faith,
verse.verse_21: And within yourselves. Can you not perceive?
verse.verse_22: There is in the heavens your sustenance, and whatever has been promised you.
verse.verse_23: By the Lord of the heavens and the earth, this is certainly true even as you speak.
verse.verse_24: Has the story of Abraham's honoured guests come to you?
verse.verse_25: When they came to him, they said: "Peace." He answered: "Peace." They were a people he did not recognise.
verse.verse_26: So he hurried to the house and brought a fatted calf,
verse.verse_27: And placing it before them said: "Won't you eat?"
verse.verse_28: He felt afraid of them; but they said: "Have no fear," and gave him the good news of a wise son.
verse.verse_29: His wife came out lamenting, striking her forehead, and said: "I, am old and barren woman?"
verse.verse_30: They said: "Thus said your Lord. He is indeed all-wise and all-knowing."
verse.verse_31: He said: "What is then your business, O messengers?"
verse.verse_32: They said: "We have been sent to a wicked people
verse.verse_33: So as to let loose clods of clay on them
verse.verse_34: Marked by your Lord for those who waste their substance."
verse.verse_35: So We evacuated everyone who was a believer there,
verse.verse_36: But did not find more than a single family of believers.
verse.verse_37: We left a sign in this for those who fear the grievous punishment,
verse.verse_38: As (there was) in Moses when We sent him to the Pharaoh with clear authority.
verse.verse_39: But he turned to his counsellors, and said: "He is a magician or lunatic."
verse.verse_40: So We seized him and his armies, and threw them into the sea, for he was worthy of blame.
verse.verse_41: In 'Ad (also is a sign), when We sent a blasting wind against them,
verse.verse_42: Which turned everything it touched to ashes.
verse.verse_43: And in Thamud, when We said to them: "Enjoy yourselves for a while;"
verse.verse_44: But they disobeyed the command of their Lord; so they were destroyed by a thunderbolt, and they could only gape,
verse.verse_45: And neither stand up nor defend themselves.
verse.verse_46: (So had We destroyed) the people of Noah before them: They were surely a sinful people.
verse.verse_47: We built the heavens by Our authority; and We are the Lord of power and expanse.
verse.verse_48: We spread the earth a carpet; what comfort We provide!
verse.verse_49: And We created pairs of everything that you may contemplate.
verse.verse_50: So turn to God. I give you a clear warning from Him.
verse.verse_51: Do not set up another god with God. I give you a clear warning from Him.
verse.verse_52: Even thus no apostle came to those before them but they said: "He is a sorcerer or a mad man."
verse.verse_53: Is this the legacy they have passed down from one to the other? In fact, they are a rebellious people.
verse.verse_54: Turn away from them. You will not be blamed.
verse.verse_55: But go on reminding them, as reminding benefits the believers.
verse.verse_56: I have not created the jinns and men but to worship Me.
verse.verse_57: I want no sustenance from them nor do I want them to feed Me.
verse.verse_58: God is certainly the great provider, Lord of strength and power.
verse.verse_59: Those who do wrong will indeed come to the same end as their fellows (of old). So let them not ask Me to hasten (the punishment).
verse.verse_60: Alas the woe for those who refuse to believe in the Day which has been promised them.
